meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能在 Emacs 里直接对话:打开聊天缓冲区提问,或把当前 org 标题/选中区域发给它,回复以内联子标题的形式出现在你的 org 文件里。
howto.when: 当 Emacs 通道启用后,你打开聊天缓冲区,或对某个 org 标题执行发送命令时触发;消息经本地 HTTP 桥接进出,无需 bot token 或外部服务。

say.text: 打开 NanoClaw 聊天缓冲区
say.note: 用你配置的键绑定打开

say.text: 把当前这个 org 标题发给你,回复写成子标题
say.note: 回复内联出现在 org 文件里

say.text: 解释一下光标所在位置的这段代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude is reachable from inside Emacs: open a chat buffer to ask questions, or send the current org subtree or region and the reply lands inline as a child heading in your org file.
howto.when_en: Triggers once the Emacs channel is enabled, when you open the chat buffer or run the org send command on a heading; messages travel over a local HTTP bridge, no bot token needed.

say_en.text: Send this org heading and write the reply as a child heading
say_en.note: reply appears inline in the org file
